title: Singing: bands rarely had vocalists, and his first song at Audubon Park
summary: Vincent says bands in his day rarely had singers. He first sang Little Liza Jane when a white woman asked him at the Audubon dance, and afterward he kept singing.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: It's three in my day sometime. She didn't have many people sing around it. And this was, you know, this youngers always had to sing. In my days sometimes, we didn't have many people singing on it, you know, with our band. And this was, you know, these youngers, always have an entertainer to sing. But in my days, we never had nobody sing with us. Sometimes we play for the white people and have a couple of them in there to sing, where they ask us to play behind them, complimenting like that. But we didn't have no songs to be with our band. The first time I ever sing, I sing Little Lies of James. When I start to travel, I always had an entertainer with them.
Where did you first sing Little Lies of James?
Up in the Audubon Tudon up there. They called us the Audubon Park, not on it. But they used to have a big dance band called the Audubon Tudon.
Yeah, a white girl asked me to sing Little Lies of James, and I sung it. And after that, they just kept singing.
You never sang with a band before, huh?
No, I never had sing with a band before.
